title: Prove fp16 accumulation loses precision vs fp32 (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C: accumulates 64 small increments (each below fp16's exact 1.0 ULP at magnitude 1024-2048) two ways -- a plain running sum vs one rounded to the nearest integer after every addition (modeling fp16's mantissa) -- executed on the software SIMT GPU; fp32-style ends at 1025.32, fp16-style is stuck at 1024.
